title: Manager Voluntary Group Archival / Dissolution

steps: 1. Manager closes all open group positions.2. Manager clicks 'Close & Dissolve MAM Group'.
expected_result: Group dissolved; LPOAs revoked for all 15 clients; full independent trading rights restored; historical records archived.
actual_result: Manager status update to 'inactive' or archival in database revokes active fan-out across all linked sub-accounts.
